lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense arrangement of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the branchial region, forming a semi-regular grid with higher density in the mid-lateral flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a high-intensity upper edge to a low-intensity shadow region below.

other_distinctive_markers: Intricate, labyrinthine pixel patterns consisting of swirled high-intensity lines and irregular blobs are visible in the supra-branchial and immediate post-branchial regions, distinct from the more regular grid further posterior.
